reviewed_by: Claude (ios-butler-projects); selection reviewed against the diff by the implementing agent, independent diff review still required before merge
reason: The NebulaShell (installed iPhone app) UI is reduced to two routes: Butler docked full screen with a project switcher and an app tab bar, and a read-only Projects snapshot of status=active projects holding at least one ordinary chat (new ShellProjects component + projectSnapshots builder). App.tsx shell routes, AppShell docked flag and NebulaControlAssistant docked mode change; the Butler workflow registry links the three new read-only calls to chat.start_and_read and approval.review. Frontend: the new snapshot builder test plus the NebulaControlAssistant and CompactSettingsList suites that exercise NebulaShell. Playwright: area:ios-assistant-only, whose test is rewritten for the new contract. Python: the workflow registry checks. Build 6 of the iOS shell bundles this UI and serves it on a loopback origin (LocalUIServer) that tunnels only /api/* to Core; its pure rewrite rules (ProxyRewrite.swift) are covered by ios/Tests/main.swift (43 checks) run with xcrun swiftc on the research Mac, and the app built unsigned for iphoneos with Xcode 27. A failed per-project read now keeps the project's card (Playwright step added).
exclusions: tests/v3/test_butler_workflow_registry.py::test_reviewed_workflow_registry_matches_ui_api_calls fails identically on origin/main (useProjectViewLease holdProjectView/releaseProjectView are unreviewed there); this change links all three of its own new calls. src/App.test.tsx has 9 failures on origin/main unrelated to the shell (desktop navigation/provider settings) and does not cover NebulaShell, so it is not selected. No backend, native (ios/ Swift unchanged; docs only) or Rust changes. No setting or operator feature reachable from the settings assistant was added, so the settings catalog is unchanged. CI has no Swift/Xcode job; the iOS checks and build ran on the research Mac and are reported in the PR.
